SFR-100 Android.name: SFR-100 Android
SFR-100 Android.description: This android effectively replace one of your crew members with a robotic counterpart. Androids possess sufficient capabilities to perform most work, but lack the capability to captain a ship or take part in boarding actions. Despite the increased price, compared to the hard to get 'NDR-114 android', they pay off after four years.

SFR-200 Android.name: SFR-200 Android
SFR-200 Android.description: This android takes part in boarding operations. Though it will only assist the crew and not replace them. First generation of SFR fighting androids. The SFR-200 is and upgraded version of the SFR-100 with increased muscle strength and tactical programming.

SFR-210 Android.name: SFR-210 Android
SFR-210 Android.description: This android takes part in boarding operations. Though it will only assist the crew and not replace them. First generation of SFR fighting androids. The SFR-210 is even more upgraded than the SFR-200, with increased muscle strength and better tactical programming.

SFR-220 Android.name: SFR-220 Android
SFR-220 Android.description: This android takes part in boarding operations. Though it will only assist the crew and not replace them. First generation of SFR fighting androids. The SFR-220 is equipped with two blades and upgraded reflexes. The tactical programming is focused on extremely fast blade fighting, making it very deadly in close combat.

SFR-300 Android.name: SFR-300 Android
SFR-300 Android.description: This android takes part in boarding operations. Though it will only assist the crew and not replace them. Second generation of SFR fighting androids. The SFR-300 is the first version of heavy armored combat androids. Despite its weight it moves very fast and the two power-fists hit hard.

SFR-310 Android.name: SFR-310 Android
SFR-310 Android.description: This android takes part in boarding operations. Though it will only assist the crew and not replace them. Second generation of SFR fighting androids. The SFR-310 is heavily armored and equipped with two needle-throwers, making it deadly even at mid-range.

SFR-320 Android.name: SFR-320 Android
SFR-320 Android.description: This android takes part in boarding operations. Though it will only assist the crew and not replace them. Second generation of SFR fighting androids. The SFR-320 is the current top model of SFR, maximally armored and with heavy weaponry. It has a small rail gun in one arm, and a heavy power fist in the other. It can only be stopped by massive counter fire and luck.
